caption: The drawing depicts an urban street scene in front of a store window display. The window, bordered by a striped awning in white and brownish tones, is filled with various toys, including wooden soldiers, a rocking horse, dolls, and a small green Christmas tree. Multiple children and adults are gathered on the sidewalk, facing the window; the children are dressed in long dresses, coats, and bonnets in colors such as blue, green, pink, and brown, while the adults wear coats and hats, with one man in a brown coat holding a child in pink. On the right side, a woman in a dark brown dress with a green hem, and a bonnet trimmed in white, stands beside a young girl in a matching brown coat with red trim, holding a green purse. In the background, several mid-rise city buildings are visible, colored in light brown, beige, and gray tones, with regularly spaced windows. On the roof of one building, a United States flag waves, featuring 13 stars in a circular pattern on a blue canton. The sidewalk is shaded in light and dark gray, and the overall palette of the drawing uses muted, naturalistic colors with occasional highlights of red, green, and blue.
title: Colored Lithograph: "New Year's Eve"
